title: Shared cross-impl vector file for the 5.03 backoff payload (C/Rust/Python parity)
description: Optional part (2) of closed bead 6lhf. The C host test lichen/tests/coap_backoff/main.c covers the parser with hand-encoded RFC 8949 fixtures, but there is no SHARED vector file pinning exact wire bytes + expected durations that C, Rust (lichen-coap client.rs), and Python (ip_coap.py) all consume. Add test/vectors/coap_503_backoff.json (or extend an existing corpus) with the canonical {reason,retry_after,level} payloads, both key orders, short/2-byte uint forms, the 3600 cap, and the malformed->60 fallbacks; wire C (coap_backoff), Rust, and Python tests to read it so the three clients agree on the same wire 5.03. Low priority — the per-impl fixtures already exist and agree.
